title: Parts filters support multiple choices and can be cleared
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open a Parts filter button that shows a list of choices.
2. Try selecting more than one choice.
3. Use the Clear selection action, then look at the filter bar for a way to clear all filters.
expected: 1. More than one value can be chosen inside a filter (to be checked live once available).
2. Clear selection removes the choices for that one filter.

3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (whether multi-select, per-filter Clear selection, and an overall Clear filters action all work the same as on the Work Orders page).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5
notes: BEHAVIOUR case — parity with Work Orders filter behaviour is assumed but not pinned by the design. Pending Branko's PRD; VIU-confirm.
